common:
Create ONE high-fidelity desktop website section mock-up for Ivy preschool's five campuses. Output a single polished widescreen UI screenshot, ideally 1792x1024 or 1536x1024, not a collage, not a computer/device mockup, no browser chrome, no presentation framing.
Reference image 1 shows the CURRENT website and exact content, colors and controls. REDESIGN its composition completely according to the variant below. Reference image 2 is the actual INTERNATIONAL CAMPUS photograph: preserve the distinctive red-brick courtyard building, repeated pointed dormers, arcade columns and roofs, do not invent a new school. Reference image 3 is the APPROVED INTERNATIONAL CAMPUS ARCHITECTURAL OUTLINE DRAWING: preserve and visibly incorporate this delicate sage school-building outline into the composition. Drawings of detached decorative trees, botanical branches, bushes, garden fences or boundary walls at the right edge are explicitly unwanted: REMOVE THEM ENTIRELY. Retain the architectural building outline, preferably without its surrounding landscaping. No separate garden illustration anywhere.
Art direction: warm refined Taiwanese preschool institutional website, spacious editorial design, warm ivory #FAF8F0 background, deep forest green #214D38 typography and primary action, pale sage map, muted gray-green fine rules. Photographic and understated, elegant real functional web design. NOT childish/cartoon, NOT SaaS dashboard, NOT glassmorphism, no giant fake shadows, no gradients, no orange accent, no decorative blobs. Meticulous grid, generous breathing room, clearly readable Traditional Chinese typography. Keep page content at plausible desktop web font sizes with heading hierarchy.
The mockup is only the campus section (no global navbar or footer). Show header 'Campuses' and '分校資訊'. Show all five selectable campus names exactly: '義華校' '明華校' '崇德校' '國際校' '仁武校', with 國際校 active. School content: '國際校', '高雄・鳥松區', '所在地', '高雄市鳥松區球場路59號', '參觀專線', '07–370–8001'. Primary button '預約參觀國際校'; quieter secondary link '認識國際校'. Include a small campus schematic map with the five location labels and selected 國際校 pin (keep it geographically schematic, copy the approximate positions from reference 1); a '規劃路線 ↗' link. Include subdued social footer links 'LINE 官方帳號｜待補' and 'Facebook 粉絲專頁 ↗', do not invent account names, handles or QR codes. Avoid repeated text or fake extra navigation. All text Traditional Chinese, not Simplified.
The building outline must read as an intentional pale supporting visual and should be visible, not fully covered or so faint it vanishes. Avoid placing outline strokes underneath contact text. A user must be able to read phone/address and find the visit button immediately. Show the entire complete section with every control inside the image, no clipping.

variants.name: A 雜誌雙欄
variants.prompt: LAYOUT A — EDITORIAL TWO-COLUMN. Left-aligned 'Campuses / 分校資訊' header at top left; compact horizontal campus tabs aligned top right with underline active state. Main body below: left 61% is an expansive landscape photograph (roughly 4:3) with restrained 12px rounded corners; right 32% is a vertically organized open contact column with school name large at top, district, address, phone, visit action, text link and socials; a SMALL low horizontal map sits at the bottom of this contact column, not above the name. Main photo and contact column start at the same top baseline. Put the pale building outline peeking from the very lower LEFT edge of the ivory section, at about 32% canvas width, separated from text and overlapping only blank margins behind photo. Fine rules and clean optical alignment. A quiet elegant magazine spread, no enclosing cards. Clear layout radically improves hierarchy over the current map-at-top composition.

variants.name: B 全幅橫景
variants.prompt: LAYOUT B — PANORAMIC PHOTO WITH LOWER INFORMATION BAND. A centered small 'Campuses' and large '分校資訊' heading with airy horizontal text tabs below. Beneath, a dominant edge-to-edge-within-container PANORAMIC photograph spanning about 87% canvas width and 37% canvas height, preserving the full actual school facade. Image has nearly square corners, no text over photo. BELOW the photograph, a single open horizontal band divided by two fine vertical rules: left column school name and district, middle address/phone and subdued social links, right column visit button and quieter campus link. Add a small pale sage map thumbnail with '規劃路線 ↗' beside the actions, not a huge map. Put the delicate architectural school outline as a ghosted horizontal drawing near the upper RIGHT of the title area on blank ivory, extending about 30% width, never touching text. This should look cinematic, broad and calm with clear horizontal layers. No large side-by-side photo/contact composition.

variants.name: C 直式選校
variants.prompt: LAYOUT C — VERTICAL CAMPUS NAVIGATION, TEXT LEFT, PHOTO RIGHT. Asymmetric editorial layout. Header 'Campuses / 分校資訊' is upper left. Beneath header, a narrow vertical rail at far LEFT (around 14% width) lists the FIVE campuses vertically with ample row spacing; active 國際校 uses a forest-green text/short horizontal rule marker, not stacked colored cards. Middle-left column (~27% width) has large school name/district, address, bold phone, primary visit button, campus link and compact social links, with a small landscape sage map at its bottom. RIGHT half (~49% width) is a very large portrait-ish 4:5 crop of the provided school photograph with clear facade architecture. Photo starts slightly above middle-left name to create an editorial stagger. Place a pale school architectural outline along the lower-right ivory margin behind and below the photo, clearly visible in blank space, no foliage/fences. Lots of negative space and no UI cards. This is visibly a THREE-column composition with vertical selection navigation and reversed content-photo relationship.

variants.name: D 線稿主視覺
variants.prompt: LAYOUT D — ARCHITECTURAL PORTRAIT, DRAWING AS FEATURE. This variant intentionally makes the approved building outline a primary supporting feature rather than tiny corner decor. Top: centered 'Campuses / 分校資訊' followed by compact horizontal campus selector. Main middle: LEFT 44% is an airy ivory architectural portrait panel, with the INTERNATIONAL school name at its upper left, district below and a large delicate sage building outline occupying most of the space below, accurately matching reference 3. RIGHT 51% is a 16:10 or 4:3 actual building photograph, simple rectangular with small rounded corners. Align tops and bottoms of these two panels; the illustration itself has NO visible rectangular border and blends into the page. Bottom: one spacious horizontal contact strip below both, with address and phone at left, a small map in center, and a prominent visit button plus campus link at right; subdued social links under contact details. The lower contact strip uses only a thin top rule. The drawing MUST stay a very fine pale gray-green contour, not full color, not dark black, not a new cartoon. No duplicate giant school label; balance drawn architecture and photograph with meaningful empty space. NO separate tree or fence drawing. The result is an architectural portfolio-like campus section with a distinctive DRAWING + PHOTO side-by-side upper composition and contact below.

variants.name: E 地圖導覽
variants.prompt: LAYOUT E — MAP-LED CAMPUS DIRECTORY. Title 'Campuses / 分校資訊' left aligned top with tiny understated '高雄・五所校園' right aligned. Body is a 36% LEFT directory column and a 59% RIGHT school showcase separated by a generous gap. Left: a large pale sage regional map around 420px wide x300px high showing five campuses, 國際校 selected with a legible outlined pin; beneath map are the FIVE campus choices as a clean two-column typographic selector separated by fine horizontal rules, 國際校 selected using a short forest-green underline, no bulky cards. Right: wide landscape photograph of the exact school, beneath it school name and district on the left and primary visit action on the right, then a clean two-column address/phone row and secondary campus/social links. '規劃路線 ↗' sits directly under map. Use a visible pale architectural building contour fading along the LOWER LEFT blank margin under directory column, no detached trees/fence. This composition prioritizes choosing by location and balances map with photography. Clearly different from variants where map is tiny or sits above phone in a narrow right column. Spacious warm ivory background and precision typography. All content fully within canvas.
